invariants.rationale: partitionPath is used as an argument and likely required to be non-null.
fileId is used in string concatenation and lookups, so it should be non-null.
recordItr is passed to constructors and may be traversed, so should not be null.
If records are empty (recordItr.hasNext() == false), partitionPath may still be required to be non-empty.
fileId is used to identify files, so an empty fileId is likely invalid.
